hostname ix-g01
!
logging buffered 131072
logging subsystem all warn
logging timestamp timeofday
!
username admin password plain 1 dummy-admin-secret-1 administrator
!
ip ufs-cache enable
!
class-map match-any cm-g-voice
  match cos 5
  match qos-group 10
!
policy-map pm-g-in
  class cm-g-voice
    set qos-group 10
  class class-local
  class class-default
!
ntp ip enable
ntp server 192.0.2.123
!
syslog ip host 192.0.2.50
syslog ip source 192.0.2.1
!
device GigaEthernet0
  description sample uplink port
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  ip address 203.0.113.69/30
  ip mtu 1454
  ip tcp adjust-mss auto
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample-lan
  ip address 198.51.100.1/24
  service-policy input pm-g-in
  no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0.0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/32
